high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the Instagram Reels section. The post features a screenshot of an app page for "Google Opinion Rewards" on the Apple App Store. The app page includes a blue header with the app's name, a description that reads "It pays to share your opinion," and the developer information "Google LLC." Below the header, there is a rating of 4.7 stars based on 124,087 reviews, and it is categorized under "Lifestyle." The screenshot also shows three screenshots of the Google Opinion Rewards app interface, displaying various survey questions and a thank-you
